verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs state its API client can create and send HTTP, GraphQL, and gRPC requests, and they mention 'multi-protocol requests' without listing which protocols. WebSocket and SSE are never named, so only half of the story's protocol list is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented WebSocket request support, documented SSE request support, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-REST protocol use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, and SSE requests, not just REST

citations.quote: Postman's API client enables you to create and send API [requests](/docs/getting-started/basics/postman-elements/#requests), including HTTP, GraphQL, and gRPC requests.
If you're not signed in to a Postman account, you can still send multi-protocol requests using the lightweight API client.
